messages.subject: Promotional poster for summer workshops
parts:
Distance-sampling list,

Several people have emailed to ask if we have a promotional poster for our
summer workshops that they can put up on their institutional notice board.
Rhona Rodger, our admin person, has created one, and I put a copy at
http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/workshops/creem_workshop_poster.pdf
Feel free to print out/forward to anyone you like! So far as I know, there
are still places on all three workshops.

There are also links to the poster on the estimating abundance workshop web
page
http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/aecourse/
and the distance sampling web page
http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance.workshops/

Cheers,

- Len
